stories.subject: Lil Baby / Bally Baby / Fatt Smaxk
stories.headline: LIL BABY TAKES THE BUS
stories.deck: Lil Baby’s “Coast 2 Coast” video with Bally Baby and Fatt Smaxk turns an Atlanta school bus into a party bus. The release arrives with his Dec. 5 State Farm Arena birthday-show announcement, keeping the city central to the rollout.
stories.verification: The Source and Hip-Hop Vibe both report the Coast 2 Coast video, its Atlanta school-bus concept, the Bally Baby/Fatt Smaxk pairing, and the Dec. 5 State Farm Arena birthday show.

stories.subject: Eminem and Kid Rock / 7 Sins
stories.headline: EMINEM + KID ROCK 7 SINS
stories.deck: Kid Rock’s Halfway to Jesus is due Oct. 17 with Eminem on “7 Sins.” Rock says the longtime friends still disagree politically, but the collaboration is meant to show that the relationship survived.
stories.verification: The Daily Beast and Hip Hop Hero both report Kid Rock’s Halfway to Jesus album, the Eminem feature on 7 Sins, the Oct. 17 date, and Rock’s explanation of their political differences.

stories.subject: Doechii / Primavera Sound Barcelona 2027
stories.headline: DOECHII HEADS TO PRIMAVERA
stories.deck: Doechii is on the announced Primavera Sound Barcelona 2027 bill, headlining a 150-plus-act lineup for June 2–6. Fan-sale registration has opened and general tickets follow Oct. 9, making the booking an early marker for next summer’s rap festival circuit.
stories.verification: The FADER and Primavera Sound’s official site both confirm the Barcelona 2027 lineup, the June 2–6 dates, Doechii’s billing, and the Oct. 8/9 ticket-sale sequence.

stories.subject: Grand Theft Auto VI / Jason and Lucia
stories.headline: GTA VI RADIO GOES WALKING
stories.deck: Rockstar revealed six GTA VI radio stations and says players can hear radio and on-demand podcasts on foot through Jason and Lucia’s phone-connected headphones. The feature expands the soundtrack beyond the car ahead of the Nov. 19 launch.
stories.verification: Rockstar’s official Newswire and VGC both report the six revealed stations, on-demand podcasts, phone-connected headphones/earbuds, and on-foot listening.

stories.subject: Mike D / Secrets Pts. I & II
stories.headline: MIKE D DROPS SECRETS
stories.deck: Mike D released the “Secrets Pts. I & II” video from his debut album Thank You, out Aug. 28 through Capitol Records. The new visual extends the project’s rollout with a focused rap performance and an official video, not just a loose teaser.
stories.verification: The Music Universe and Rap Industry both report Mike D’s Secrets Pts. I & II video, its connection to the Thank You debut album, and the Aug. 28 Capitol release.

source_policy: At least two current reputable sources per story; five distinct stories; no stale or repeated topics from prior batches.
